description: This file is a reference implementation of JSON parsing and stringifying functions, creating a global JSON object with methods 'stringify' and 'parse'. It includes custom toJSON methods for Date objects and handles JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: JSON.stringify
methods.description: Converts a JavaScript value to a JSON string, with optional replacer and space parameters.

methods.name: JSON.parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JavaScript object or array, with an optional reviver function.
